events.title: Boliden AB (BLIDF) Q1 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Strong Financial Performance Amid ...
events.body: Boliden AB (BLIDF) reports robust EBIT and cash flow despite significant setbacks at Garpenberg, with positive impacts from metal prices and strategic guidance for future production.

events.title: Garpenberg Seismic Halt Tests Boliden Production Reliability And Earnings Story
events.body: Abnormal seismic activity at Boliden's Garpenberg mine triggered a full evacuation and production halt. Both mining and concentrator operations are currently stopped pending inspections and safety checks. The company has not provided a time
